About

Building with purpose

I'm a Computer Engineering student who likes turning ideas into tools people can actually use. My work sits at the intersection of software, hardware, and interface design, with a strong focus on clarity, reliability, and usefulness in real situations.

I built projects like disaster-response PWAs, AI-powered classification tools, and embedded systems because I want to grow into an engineer who can solve practical problems for communities and organizations, not just ship polished demos.

I care about systems that stay helpful under pressure, work well on modest devices, and make complicated tasks feel simpler for the people who depend on them.

Lead Web Developer · Jan – Apr 2026

Resilink — Disaster Response PWA

Resilink is a Progressive Web App designed for LGU disaster response coordination across Antequera and San Isidro, Bohol. It provides real-time Firestore database sync, FCM push notifications via a Vercel serverless backend, full offline support for low-connectivity emergencies, an admin panel for LGU personnel, community incident reporting with trust scoring and anti-abuse protection, a Leaflet-powered live map showing reports, heritage sites, and evacuation centers, and disaster survival guides across multiple categories.

View GitHub Repo Live Site
What I Built
  • Designed and developed the full Progressive Web App architecture.
  • Implemented Firestore real-time synchronization for incident reporting.
  • Built offline-first functionality using local caching and queued sync.
  • Developed FCM push notification integration using Vercel serverless functions.
  • Engineered the Leaflet-based disaster mapping system with evacuation and heritage site layers.
  • Created admin moderation tools with anti-abuse and trust-score mechanisms.
  • Built responsive mobile-first UI optimized for low-connectivity environments.
Tech Stack
JavaScript Firebase Firestore FCM PWA Vercel Leaflet HTML/CSS
Features
Home Screen
Main dashboard for LGU personnel showing all modules — Map View, Reports, Heritage, Announcements, Survival Guides, and Dashboard — with a live status indicator.
Live Map
Leaflet-powered map of Antequera, Bohol showing real-time pins for community reports, evacuation center statuses, and heritage sites — filterable by layer.
Disaster Guides
Typhoon preparedness guide with 30 actionable tips split into Before, During, and After phases — tailored for the Philippine context with PAGASA references.
Resource Guides
Community resource library covering Renewable Energy, Water Purification, Waste Management, and Disaster Preparedness — with collapsible topic sections.
Announcements
LGU announcement board for posting categorized notices. Supports offline sync — posts queue locally and push to Firestore once back online.
Heritage Reports
Site observation logs for local heritage structures. Each report tracks status, submission date, and condition — helping LGU monitor cultural assets during disasters.
Lead Developer - Jan - Apr 2026

TimberScan - Lumber Identification App

TimberScan is a Flutter mobile application that identifies lumber types from live camera images using a trained Convolutional Neural Network. As Lead Developer, I built the mobile workflow, trained and prepared the model in Google Colab, converted it for TensorFlow Lite, and integrated on-device inference so classifications could run in real time without relying on a constant internet connection.

View GitHub Repo
What I Built
  • Designed and developed the entire application architecture.
  • Trained and integrated a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model for image classification.
  • Built the image upload and preprocessing pipeline for real-time inference.
  • Implemented model prediction handling and confidence-based output display.
  • Developed the frontend interface for dataset interaction and result visualization.
  • Optimized the workflow for lightweight and responsive performance.
  • Designed the complete UI/UX and application flow.
Tech Stack
Flutter Dart Python CNN Google Colab TensorFlow Lite Mobile Camera
Features
Live Camera Scan
Camera-based capture flow for framing lumber samples and sending frames through the on-device classifier.
Classification Result
Result view showing the predicted lumber type, confidence score, and comparison values for nearby classes.
ML Pipeline
CNN training in Google Colab, TensorFlow Lite conversion, and deployment into the Flutter application.
Systems Integrator - Jan - Apr 2026

BaoMeter - Fare System

BaoMeter is an electronic fare system designed for BaoBao vehicles, using a hall sensor to detect passenger movement and automate fare counting. As Systems Integrator, I connected the sensor input, embedded control logic, display behavior, and fare computation flow into one reliable prototype.

What I Built
  • Led the system implementation and core functionality development.
  • Engineered the application logic and ensured overall system reliability.
  • Integrated and tested key system components to maintain stable operation.
  • Handled debugging, workflow validation, and feature optimization.
  • Collaborated with the team to translate project requirements into a functional working system.
  • Ensured the platform operated correctly across different use-case scenarios.
Tech Stack
C++ Arduino Hall Sensor ISR State Machine Embedded Systems
Features
Prototype System
Hardware and display prototype for tracking passenger count and calculated fare output.
State Machine
READY, COUNTING, and STOPPED states keep the sensor workflow predictable during trips.
